exercises.title: Cap rate both ways
exercises.intro: Value is NOI divided by a cap rate (F-CORE-13). Small rate moves make large value moves, so always test plus and minus 25 basis points.

calculator.task: Birchwood Plaza's stabilized NOI is $480,000. The appraiser used 8.00%, which gives $6,000,000. What is the value if the cap rate is 8.25%? Then try 7.75%. Going the other way, $480,000 ÷ $6,000,000 gives the implied cap rate of 8.00%. At 8.25%, does the $3,900,000 term loan still pass the 65% LTV limit?

exercises.title: Which value do we lend on?
exercises.intro: Each loan test uses one value. On a purchase, the as-is value is the lower of the price and the appraisal (F-CORE-14). Pick a case, then walk the path.

options.label: Day-one advance or purchase LTV (as-is test)
Bridge stabilized test or term loan at refinance

purchase.q: Is the loan financing a purchase?

compare.q: Is the as-is appraisal below the purchase price?

options.label: No, the appraisal is equal or higher

end_price.explain: On a purchase, value is the lower of price and appraisal (F-CORE-14). A high appraisal cannot create equity the buyer has not paid for.

end_appraisal.explain: The appraisal is the lower figure, so it is the value (F-CORE-14). The day-one loan shrinks and the buyer brings more equity.

end_refi.result: Lend on the as-is appraisal alone.
end_refi.explain: There is no price on a refinance, so LTV uses the appraisal (F-CORE-14, job aid).

end_arv.explain: Loan-to-ARV divides the total loan by the after-repair value (F-RES-02). ARV never replaces as-is in the day-one test.

end_stab.explain: The bridge stabilized LTV and the term loan use the value once leased up (F-MF-13; COM-TRM). Never put it in an as-is test.

cases.text: Maple Run day-one advance: price $300,000; as-is appraisal $310,000 (RD-RES-01)
Cedar Court day-one funding: price $6,200,000; as-is appraisal $6,300,000 (RD-MF-01)
Birchwood Plaza bridge: price $4,400,000; as-is appraisal $4,500,000 (RD-COM-01)
What-if: Cedar Court's as-is appraisal comes in at $6,000,000, below the $6,200,000 price (practice 6)
Maple Run loan-to-ARV: $340,000 total loan; ARV $520,000 (RD-RES-01)
Birchwood term loan at month 24: as-stabilized value $6,000,000 (RD-COM-01)

exercises.title: Is the appraisal too old?
exercises.intro: Appraisal age runs from the effective date of value to closing, in actual days (F-CORE-36). It passes at no more than 120 days (CORE-VAL-02).

calculator.task: Suppose Cedar Court's appraisal is effective 19 Jul 2026 and closing is 20 Nov 2026 (practice 4). How old is it at closing? Does it pass CORE-VAL-02? Then change the effective date to 23 Jul 2026 and check again.
